name: VR Locker Lite
summary: VR Locker Lite is a hedging-based Expert Advisor that opens opposing positions to lock in profits or limit losses when the market moves against an initial trade. It uses a locker mechanism to open a hedging order when a defined loss threshold is reached, effectively creating a locked position until a breakout or recovery signal allows closure. The EA manages both the original and hedging positions together, aiming to exit the overall basket at a profit or minimal loss.
summary_zh: VR Locker Lite是一款基于对冲锁仓机制的智能交易系统，当市场价格对初始持仓不利并达到设定的亏损阈值时，自动开立反向头寸进行锁仓，形成对冲状态以限制进一步亏损。EA同时管理原始头寸和对冲头寸，在市场出现突破或恢复信号时整体平仓，力求以盈利或最小亏损退出。
strategy_analysis: VR Locker Lite的策略核心是锁仓对冲机制，当初始持仓浮亏达到设定阈值时，EA自动开立等量反向订单形成锁仓状态，阻止亏损继续扩大。入场条件是初始交易信号触发后开仓，当浮亏达到指定点数或金额时触发锁仓对冲订单。出场条件是当市场价格突破锁仓区间或出现恢复信号时，EA同时关闭两个对冲头寸，以整体盈利或可控亏损退出。仓位管理方面，锁仓订单的手数通常与原始头寸相同，确保完全对冲。资金管理依赖于锁仓阈值参数和整体平仓目标，缺乏严格的止损机制，锁仓可能导致长期持有对冲头寸而占用保证金。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在单边趋势中锁仓后难以找到合适的解锁时机，可能导致资金长期被锁定。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of VR Locker Lite is a locking hedging mechanism where the EA automatically opens an equal and opposite position when the floating loss of the initial trade reaches a defined threshold, effectively freezing further equity erosion. Entry conditions begin with an initial trade signal, and the hedge order triggers when unrealized loss exceeds a configured pip or monetary threshold. Exit conditions rely on the market breaking out of the locked range or showing a reversal signal, at which point both the original and hedging positions are closed simultaneously for an overall net gain or minimal loss. Position sizing for the hedge order typically mirrors the original lot size to achieve a complete hedge lock. Money management depends on the lock threshold parameter and the overall closure target, but lacks a strict hard stop-loss mechanism, meaning locked positions can tie up margin for extended periods. The strategy performs better in ranging markets where price oscillates within the lock zone, but struggles in strong trending conditions where unlocking the hedge becomes difficult and capital remains immobilized.

parameters.name: Lock_Level
parameters.description: 触发锁仓的浮亏点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Floating loss in points to trigger lock

parameters.name: Take_Profit
parameters.description: 整体平仓目标利润点数
parameters.description_en: Overall close target in profit points

parameters.name: Lock_Lot_Multiplier
parameters.description: 锁仓手数倍率，1.0为等量对冲

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 锁仓机制有效限制单笔交易的最大亏损，在突发事件中提供保护
对冲后可以在市场恢复时整体盈利退出，充分利用价格回归特性
策略逻辑清晰，参数直观易懂，适合不同经验的交易者使用
pros_en: The locking mechanism effectively caps the maximum loss on a single trade, providing protection during sudden market events
After hedging, the EA can exit with overall profit when the market reverts, capitalizing on mean-reverting price behavior
The strategy logic is clear and parameters are intuitive, making it accessible for traders with varying experience levels
cons: 锁仓后双倍持仓占用大量保证金，资金利用率低
缺乏硬性止损，如果解锁信号长期不出现，账户可能因保证金不足而爆仓
在强趋势行情中锁仓后难以找到合适解锁时机，可能导致长期套牢
cons_en: Locked positions require double margin, significantly reducing capital efficiency and available free margin
Absence of a hard stop-loss means the account could face margin calls if an unlock signal never materializes
In strong trending markets, finding an appropriate unlock timing is extremely difficult, potentially leading to prolonged capital lock-up
improvements: 增加硬性止损机制，当锁仓持续超过设定时间或亏损超过阈值时强制平仓
加入趋势过滤指标（如ADX或均线方向），在强趋势中避免锁仓而直接止损
improvements_en: Add a hard stop-loss mechanism that forces closure when the locked state persists beyond a set duration or cumulative loss exceeds a threshold
Incorporate a trend filter indicator (e.g., ADX or moving average direction) to avoid locking in strong trends and instead cut losses directly

risk_points: 锁仓后双倍持仓消耗大量保证金，在波动剧烈时可能导致保证金不足
缺乏硬性止损和超时强制平仓机制，极端行情下可能无法及时解锁
risk_points_en: Double margin consumption from locked positions can lead to insufficient free margin during high volatility
No hard stop-loss or timeout forced closure mechanism means unlocking may be impossible in extreme market conditions
